data.name: ExperimentalThanks
data.value: Ngā mihi mō tō whakamātau i te pukapuka kupu whakamātau. Tukuna mai ō whakaaro hei whakapai ake i te huinga kōrero ipurangi, mēnā ka kitea e koe he hapa, he whakamāoritanga rānei e rite ana te tangi. Whakahuatia te putanga o te pūmanawa, ngā ingoa o ngā reo, ngā takirua kupu me ngā whakapainga. Ko te mea pai rawa atu, kohia ngā whakaaro whakapai katoa ka tuku ngātahi ai.

data.name: ExperimentalVocabularyBook
data.value: Mō tēnei takirua reo, he pukapuka kupu whakamātau kei reira, ā, kei raro i te raihana ōrite ki tā te pūmanawa. I hangaia hei akoranga haere tonu mā ngā pakeke, heoi kāore anō kia arotakehia e ngā kaikōrero taketake o te reo. Kei te hiahia koe ki te whakamātau?
